nodes.label: Graphify Workflow for Rattio/Lúmen
nodes.rationale: The knowledge graph at graphify-out/ serves as the primary map of the codebase, to be consulted before any code search or question answering. After modifying code, run graphify update . to keep the graph current.

nodes.label: Lúmen Dark Theme Design System
nodes.rationale: A sophisticated dark-mode palette providing a high-contrast environment that reduces eye strain while maintaining a premium financial terminal feel. Uses triple-font approach: Newsreader for editorial headlines, Work Sans for functional UI, JetBrains Mono for financial data. Zero shadows — depth achieved through tonal layering and structural outlines.

nodes.label: Lúmen Gestão Financeira Design System
nodes.rationale: Personal finance dashboard for Brazilian users built on the principle that financial data should feel like reading a serious newspaper — precise, high-contrast, and completely free of decorative noise. Uses Swiss Style editorial minimalism with utilitarian rigour. Rebranded from Rattio to Lúmen on 01/05/2026.

nodes.label: Financial Newspaper Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: The aesthetic balances the intellectual weight of a traditional broadsheet with the high-velocity precision of modern fintech. Prioritizes information density, legibility, and structural authority over decorative reassurance. Dividers (not whitespace) separate sections, mimicking print newspaper structural rules.

nodes.label: Single-Hue Brand Color Discipline
nodes.rationale: Teal 700 (#0F766E) is the sole saturated brand color, used on primary buttons, active sidebar state, focus rings, and chart income bars — all tied to one meaning. Semantic colors (Emerald for income, Red for expense) are deliberately separate, following financial convention without competing with the teal brand.

nodes.label: Financial Precision Through Tabular Numbers
nodes.rationale: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code handles all financial figures with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums — numbers align vertically in columns, and the slightly condensed tracking packs more digits into tight card spaces without sacrificing legibility.

nodes.label: Hero Balance Component
nodes.rationale: 60px Inter Bold at letter-spacing -0.03em — the most important number, the 'lede' users should read from across the room. The burnt-orange rule (#C2410C at 30% opacity) below it is the only purely decorative element in the entire design system, referencing newspaper column dividers.

nodes.label: KPI Cards with Colored Accent Bars
nodes.rationale: Four KPI cards (Income, Expenses, Balance, Investment) each carry a 3px colored accent bar along the top edge for at-a-glance variant recognition without coloring the entire background. Three tiers of information in 80px of vertical space: uppercase label at 11px → mono value at 22px → delta arrow with percentage.
nodes.norm_label: kpi cards with colored accent bars

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation with Navy Background
nodes.rationale: Deep navy (#0A1628) sidebar functions as the masthead while the near-white (#F8FAFC) main canvas is the broadsheet page. Active state uses a 3px teal left-edge bar rather than a full background fill. Each nav item shows a Fira Code keyboard shortcut badge on hover.

nodes.label: Financial Health Score
nodes.rationale: A single 0–100 score computed across four financial criteria (savings rate, budget adherence, active goals, positive balance). Score bar uses transition width 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — spring easing that makes the fill feel alive, not mechanical.

nodes.label: Editorial Bar Chart Design
nodes.rationale: Bar charts use thin 12px bars with rounded tops only, reading as clean vertical marks rather than chunky BI-style pillars. Chart grid lines are dashed (3 3) at 50% opacity — present for alignment but invisible at a glance. Tooltips are minimal with 2px border radius.

nodes.label: Transaction List Items with Expanding Row
nodes.rationale: Each transaction item uses padding 14px 0 with a bottom border — no card wrapping. On hover, the item gains a background fill and momentarily shifts padding to 14px 10px with negative margin (-10px) — the expanding row pattern that adds visual depth without layout reflow.
nodes.norm_label: transaction list items with expanding row

nodes.label: Rules of Hooks — Never Violate
nodes.rationale: React hooks must only be called at the top level of a component. Placing hooks inside nested functions, conditionals, or loops caused real bugs in Dashboard.jsx that were corrected by Base44 bot.

nodes.label: Material Symbols Instead of Lucide React
nodes.rationale: The project migrated from lucide-react to Material Symbols Outlined for visual icons. Lucide-react is retained only for action icons (Pencil, Trash2, Copy) in legacy components.
nodes.norm_label: material symbols instead of lucide react

nodes.label: Migration from shadcn Card to Design System Tokens
nodes.rationale: The project is migrating from shadcn/ui Card/CardContent components to direct divs with design_lumen.md tokens (bg-surface, border-surface-border, p-card-padding) for consistency with the design system.
nodes.norm_label: migration from shadcn card to design system tokens

nodes.label: LocalStorage Data Validation Rule
nodes.rationale: getLocal() returns JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(...)) which may return corrupted data of unexpected type. Always validate with Array.isArray() or type checks before using localStorage data. Apply validation both at the store function level and in consuming components.

nodes.label: Base44 Data Entities
nodes.rationale: Eight entities power the app: Transaction (with source field: cron_salary, cron_recurring), Budget (with isRecurring for auto-replication), Goal (with progressMode manual/linked), Card (credit cards), Rule (auto-categorization), Template (transaction templates), FixedTemplate (cron-generated recurring), Setting (key-value config). All use real-time subscribe.

nodes.label: React Query → Base44 SDK → MongoDB Data Architecture
nodes.rationale: Cloud-first architecture: Component → React Query (30s cache) → Base44 SDK → MongoDB. localStorage serves as offline fallback. First-time sync migrates localStorage data to cloud when cloud is empty. Deduplication runs automatically once per session via _autoDeduplicate() in initStore().
nodes.norm_label: react query → base44 sdk → mongodb data architecture

nodes.label: Base44 Cron Backend Functions
nodes.rationale: Five Deno serverless functions: generateRecurring (cron day 1, generates FixedTemplate transactions), generateSalary (cron day 5, generates monthly salary), generateRecurringBudgets (cron day 1, replicates recurring budgets), sendInvoiceReminder (cron daily, 3 days before due), sendBudgetAlert (cron daily, when budget exceeded). Maximum 50 functions per project.

nodes.label: Modular Store Refactoring
nodes.rationale: The original 866-line store.js was refactored into modules under src/lib/store/: helpers.js, cards.js, rules.js, templates.js, settings.js, clearAllData.js, dedup.js. A barrel file (store.js) re-exports all, maintaining the '@/lib/store' import path.

nodes.label: CSV Installment Series Expansion
nodes.rationale: expandInstallmentSeries() detects installment patterns like '5/10' in CSV descriptions and generates all installments (retroactive, current, and future), each labeled with _seriesLabel. Deduplication marks already-existing installments as _duplicateSeries.

nodes.label: Bugfix: MONTH_SHORT Crash in financeUtils.js
nodes.rationale: Priority 1 crash. formatSmartDate() uses MONTH_SHORT but the file only re-exports it without importing it locally. Re-export does not create a binding in the module scope. Fix: add named import from './categories'.

nodes.label: Bugfix: Onboarding Repeats Every Session
nodes.rationale: Priority 1. Onboarding check is purely synchronous via localStorage, so it fires on every new device/browser. fetchOnboarded() exists but is not called in Dashboard. Fix: add async cloud check before showing onboarding.

nodes.label: Bugfix: Multi-Tenancy localStorage Isolation
nodes.rationale: Priority 1. LS_PREFIX = 'rattio_' is static, shared by all users on the same browser. Settings like onboarded, salaryConfig, dashSections are in the same key space regardless of logged-in user. Fix: dynamic prefix with userId from base44.auth.currentUser.

nodes.label: Bugfix: Date Input Year Without Limit
nodes.rationale: Priority 1. type='date' inputs allow indefinite year input (e.g., 11/05/20266666). Fix: add clampDateInput utility with max 2099/min 1900 and apply to all date inputs across TransactionModal, Goals, Budgets, CalendarPage.
nodes.norm_label: bugfix: date input year without limit

nodes.label: Improvement: Shared Chart Theme
nodes.rationale: Priority 3. Create a shared chartTheme.js with CHART_COLORS, CHART_TOOLTIP_STYLE, AXIS_STYLE, and GRID_STYLE to apply consistent visual styling across Dashboard and Reports chart components.

nodes.label: Improvement: Mobile Responsiveness
nodes.rationale: Priority 3. Elements overflow on viewports < 430px. Fix: global box-sizing, overflow-x hidden on body, flex-wrap on headers and tabs, overflow-x-auto wrappers on tables, responsive grid columns. Sidebar must start closed on mobile.

nodes.label: Transactions Page HTML Prototype
nodes.rationale: Static HTML prototype demonstrating the Transactions page layout with sidebar navigation, top app bar, KPI summary row, bento layout (transaction form + filtered list), mobile bottom nav, and FAB. Uses Lúmen design tokens throughout.

nodes.label: Lúmen Main Logo (Hexagonal)
nodes.rationale: The Lúmen logo uses a hexagonal clip-path — six-sided, like a crystal or carbon lattice. The letterform 'L' appears in Fira Code monospace inside a teal hexagon, connecting the brand to precision, code, and light (lúmen = unit of luminous flux). Used as the favicon in index.html.

nodes.rationale: Original 487KB HTML file kept in repo for visual reference. Contains the full legacy implementation with sidebar, dashboard, transaction modal, calendar, goals, budgets, reports, settings, global search, and CSV import.
